main_body: Raised wooden hut (stilt coop/farm shed): a large plank roof slab over a plank wall with a small door and window, on stilts
top_band: Row 0 is an outline, row 1 is a 1px light edge (#d9a566), then rows 2-15 are the same brown family as the roof face (L~98). No distinct top surface, only the 1px highlight line
evidence: The roof is drawn as a flat front-facing plank panel. Column x=21 shows an outline at row 0, a 1px highlight at row 1, then rows 2-15 at L=98 as plank face, with a darker band at rows 16-20 as the eave. No roof slope is shown as a lighter horizontal band, so there is no top surface of at least 3 rows. The wall below is flat vertical planks with a door and window painted on, with only a dark frame and no real inset. The floor ledge at row 35 is a 1px line. Overall it is a front elevation with a 1px highlight line on top, which fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 7 colours per tile, against 66-185 colours and 11-18 per tile for the references. Its ramps are shallow: roof planks have about 3 browns plus highlight and outline, and the wall is a single mid-dark brown with dark plank gaps. Outlines are a tinted dark brown (0% neutral), which fits the standard. The plank lines give some texture, with no 5x5 flat fills. It lacks the per-tile highlights, grain and material variety of the references, so it reads thinner and flatter next to them.
